ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Scheduled"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Candidate Confirmed"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Rescheduled") ), OR( ISBLANK(Scheduled_Start__c), ISBLANK(Scheduled_End__c), ISPICKVAL(Interview_Mode__c, "") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Scheduled Start, Scheduled End, and Interview Mode are required for scheduled interviews.
